limitations: Assisted game flight, bounded pitch/bank; not certified performance or exact cockpit replicas.
No autorotation, vortex-ring model, fuel/engine systems, aerobatics, weapons or crash deformation.
Physics uses coarse airframe probes against nearby resident geometry; imported hull extraction is capped at 128.
Cockpit controls are operated by the documented input bindings; most physical switches are visual details.
Session-local raised practice airfield; aircraft positions do not persist through page reload.

Ground shadows and original overall scale are retained.
